title: Rosemary Beach: Ocean Breeze in Inlet Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Ocean Breeze in Inlet Beach. Ocean Breeze Cottage brings you everything you could ask for in a beachfront residence.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at The Bluffs with 2 sets of beach chairs and the Beach Better Box included (March 1 - October 31) . Additional beach service chairs can be rented through Jake's Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Ocean Breeze Cottage brings you everything you could ask for in a beachfront residence. This spectacular Gulf front home is the perfect place to gather with family and friends. Located just east of Rosemary Beach, this is one of the few exclusive homes in the Bluffs at Inlet Beach and offers direct beach access. Enjoy 130 ft of beachfront excellence from the multiple porches and balconies offering panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico. The first level loggia is the perfect place to relax, enjoy grilling, and sit by the built-in fireplace. Enjoy the beach front view while mere steps to the community pool and private walkover.

On the second main level of the home, entertaining will be seamless with the open floor plan where you find a stunning chef's kitchen with white quarts countertops, large island, glossy subway tile back splash, two dishwashers, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and Monogram GE appliances. Relax in the gorgeously appointed coffered ceiling living area and dine in the ample dining area. A convenient laundry and storage room is found off the kitchen as well as a lovely powder room. A beautiful master suite with coffered ceiling provides a welcome retreat and includes an exquisite marble en-suite bath with double vanities.

The third level landing provides a convenient additional laundry area with storage, marble counters and a sink. A serene master bedroom provides access to a private gulf-front balcony with spectacular views. The master bath offers a spa-like experience with marble counters, soaking tub, large shower, and double vanities. Two additional guest bedrooms with ensuite baths are beautifully appointed and complete the third level of the home.

The fourth level of the home features an expansive great room, full bath with shower, and built in ship-lap beds and trundles to accommodate guests. Step out onto the balcony for the remarkable view of the beautiful beach and Gulf.

KEY FEATURES:

350 ft of private beach for The Bluffs of Inlet Beach

Gulf Front

2 sets of beach chairs (March 1 - October 31)

Beach Better Box (March 1 - October 31)

Exclusive access to the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center and Racquet Club

Access to community pool (Heated Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Years, and March 1 - Easter)

Please note: This community prohibits beach tents, canopies, sunshades, or wind assisted shades that may look like a tent. A beach umbrella is permitted.

PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER SATURDAY - SATURDAY

No access to Rosemary pools or beaches
